sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: phone_capabilities
toolsAdded.description: Read current Android phone permissions, accessibility and stop state.

toolsAdded.name: phone_open_url
toolsAdded.description: Request Android VIEW for an HTTPS URL. Dispatch does not prove page arrival and does not satisfy Accessibility launcher-click acceptance.

toolsAdded.name: phone_files_write_read
toolsAdded.description: Create and read back a bounded file only in the folder previously selected through Android consent.

toolsAdded.name: phone_notifications
toolsAdded.description: Read bounded separate fixture notifications after notification access is granted.

toolsAdded.name: phone_fixture_notify
toolsAdded.description: Ask the separate cooperating fixture app to post its harmless test notification.

toolsAdded.name: phone_capture_request
toolsAdded.description: Request fresh system screen-capture consent; user must decide. Does not grant consent.

toolsAdded.name: phone_capture_result
toolsAdded.description: Read metadata of the consented capture; no input control or private oracle access.

Call phone_fixture_notify once, then phone_notifications once and report the separate fixture package/id/text. Open "https://example.org/?olea=m5-pi-final-seven-01" with phone_open_url once. Use only these phone tools: phone_capabilities, phone_capture_request, phone_capture_result, phone_files_write_read, phone_fixture_notify, phone_notifications, phone_open_url. Do not request folder consent, change permissions, inspect private files, read oracle state, or use shell/ADB to control Android. Capture image input is not supplied; do not claim visual capture interpretation. Record factual results only. At most7phone calls; no retry or replay after uncertain delivery. Operator selected stock full access/approval never for Codex; Kotlin remains phone permission authority. Finish after these operations. Acceptance marker 6ee249978d6a5b01e660208947f2289d.
